title: The 4th lord is in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 4th house, the house of schooling, sits in a kendra or trikona.
text.impact: Schooling tends to go smoothly: a settled place to study, and an education that is finished rather than cut short.

text.en: The lord of the 4th house, the house of schooling, sits in a dusthana, which classical texts read as interruptions in education.
text.impact: Schooling may be interrupted, or take place away from home, or the household may be unsettled during the study years. Continuity matters more here than the choice of school.

text.en: The lord of the 5th house, the house of intelligence, sits in a kendra or trikona.
text.impact: Learning comes naturally. You tend to grasp things quickly and to enjoy the subjects you choose.

text.en: The lord of the 5th house, the house of intelligence, sits in a dusthana, which classical texts read as effort needed in studies.
text.impact: Concentration can take more effort than it does for others, and early results may not reflect your ability. A set routine and a teacher who explains well make a real difference.

text.impact: A teacher's blessing, in the traditional phrase. Good guidance tends to appear at the right moment, and learning has a thoughtful, principled quality to it.

title: Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu occupies the 4th house

text.en: A natural malefic sits in the 4th house, the house of schooling, which classical texts read as disruption to settled study.
text.impact: The study years may have some disruption around them: a move, an unsettled household, or pressure at home. Steady surroundings help more than extra tuition.

title: Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu occupies the 5th house

text.en: A natural malefic sits in the 5th house, the house of intelligence, which classical texts read as effort needed to focus.
text.impact: Focus can be harder to hold, and the mind gets restless. Short, regular study sessions tend to work much better than long ones.

text.en: The lords of the 5th (intelligence) and 9th (higher learning) houses are related, classically favourable for higher studies.
text.impact: Further study is supported: degrees, research or specialised training, often with help from teachers or family.

text.impact: The chart read specifically for learning agrees, which strengthens the promise of a good education.

title: Mercury is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.en: Mercury, the karaka of intellect and learning, is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign.
text.impact: A quick, clear mind. You tend to learn by understanding rather than by rote, and you can explain what you know to others.

text.en: Mercury, the karaka of intellect and learning, is debilitated, unless the debilitation is cancelled.
text.impact: Learning may need more repetition, and you may doubt your own grasp of a subject more than you need to. Writing things down, and explaining them to someone else, helps a great deal.
